source: ocp-mgmt monitoring/prometheus; stored samples queried read-only via local port forward
operator_observations: Unrelated pfSense Unbound issue prolonged some metric failures; use ping recovery for Internet recovery.
method: Raw JSON contains original instant-query range-vector responses, not query_range lookback-filled samples. queries.json contains selectors; query time is end_inclusive, with a 4303662ms range.
Charts use the exact requested dashboard window. Raw evidence includes five extra minutes of lead-in.

Ping loss is the stored guarded one-minute rule, evaluated with a 30-second publication offset; the stored timestamp denotes the measurement window. Fifteen-second counter deltas refine boundaries but are not packet-capture timestamps.

WAN Mbps = nonnegative delta(ix2 octet counter)*8/actual interval/1e6. Modem packets/s = nonnegative delta(packet counter)/actual scrape interval; cached modem polling and scrape times differ. Gaps over 90 seconds or counter resets produce unknown rates.

CSV rows use each recorded loss timestamp. Other metrics use latest preceding sample within 60 seconds, with source timestamp columns. Failed modem collection suppresses cached modem values; missing/nonfinite values are blank.
Service chart uses latest sample within 20 seconds per target on a 15-second grid; count shown only if all targets in that category have samples. DNS has two targets; HTTPS has ten.
Uptime is firmware-reported interface uptime and SNMP agent uptime, not proven device reboot telemetry. No DOCSIS RF or cable event logs were available.
Unbound explanation and no manual power cycle are operator observations. No resolver logs were retrieved. No cluster or modem resource mutations or active connectivity tests were performed.
PDF and PNG generated with matplotlib 3.11.2 and reportlab 5.0.1; build-report.py regenerates derived artifacts offline.
